items.title: Nicki Parrott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 2, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Chris Brubeck actually lives in not far from here in Wilton, I believe near where Dave lived, Dave Brubeck.

ctx.x: We met them at the jazz convention in New Orleans, they were doing the Brubeck thing.
Yeah, Chris Brubeck actually lives in not far from here in Wilton, I believe near where Dave lived, Dave Brubeck. Super sweet guys. Great guys.

You anticipated a question I was going to ask and that is most musicians were sitting waiting for the phone to ring and the more it rang, the more we knew what was coming. Like okay this is cancelled, now who’s next? But I was going to ask if you had to initiate cancellations and indeed you have quite a —
